# Moniruzzaman Saikat

> Senior software engineer in Dhaka, Bangladesh with 7+ years of experience using AI to build production-grade software: SaaS products, desktop apps and automation tools with Laravel, TypeScript, Electron and C++.

## Approach: AI-assisted, human-reviewed, production-ready
- AI speeds up implementation; Saikat owns the architecture and every decision that reaches production.
- All generated code is reviewed and verified with tests, type checking and linting.
- Security, reliability, deployment and long-term maintainability are handled deliberately.
- Live products (TimoDesk, BuildEcom) are shipped and supported, not prototypes.

## Key facts
- Role: Senior software engineer
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Experience: 7+ years
- Shipped: 2 SaaS products (TimoDesk, BuildEcom); runs BD Devs; 169+ public GitHub repositories
- Main stack: Laravel, TypeScript, Electron, C++
- Also: JavaScript, Python, PHP, C#/.NET, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Win32 API, N-API, Git, Linux

## Products
- [TimoDesk](https://timodesk.com): Time tracking and workforce analytics SaaS platform.
- [BuildEcom](https://buildecom.app): No-code WooCommerce mobile app builder.
- [BD Devs](https://bddevs.tech): Community platform for developers in Bangladesh (articles, developers, companies, salaries, showcase, jobs, Q&A).

## Open source
- [win-track](https://github.com/monirsaikat/win-track): Active window and URL tracker for Windows (C++).
- [napi](https://github.com/monirsaikat/napi): Native Node.js addon experiments using N-API (C++).
- [design-patterns](https://github.com/monirsaikat/design-patterns): Design patterns with documentation and code (Python).
